reviews.text: Holly is a great vet and has been really helpful with our cat who has hyperthyroidism, supporting us through a referral to get radioactive treatment. Our cat can get really stressed at the vet, and this practice has a much calmer atmosphere than others we’ve been to. There’s a quiet room you can sit in with your cat before your appointment so they don’t get stressed by other animals in the waiting area, which has really helped. Very reasonable prices as well!

I took my French bull dog Skylah to Hello Vet as she was poorly with an ear infection. She had to be sedated as she was not cooperating with an examination. I found Dr Olivia and other Veterinary staff to be gentle, supportive and animal focused in their approach. The follow up service was excellent. I feel that there was genuine interest and care given in Skylah’s treatment and would definitely recommend Hello Vet, London Fields ☺️

Little Skylah has a so much better and had returned to he happy bubbly self 🤩

Dear Helen, thanks so much for leaving us a positive review, it's much appreciated. If you need anything else, you know where to find us! 
Warm wishes, 
Your Hello Vet team

Have had nothing but amazing experiences at Hello Vet — especially when our reactive dog needed emergency stitches.

Appointments are seamless and staff are knowledgeable and caring. It’s not the cheapest vet BUT the quality of care and the fact that you can WhatsApp them whenever makes it completely worth it.

Also: for anyone with a difficult or reactive dog — it’s the only vet practice I’ve been to where staff listen to your concerns and have protocols in place (eg a separate quiet waiting room so we don’t need to be beside a miaowing cat!)

I almost can’t believe the service and genuine care that we receive from Hello Vet at London Fields. This place is different!! I originally picked this place because it looked cool and sounded like they offered all the services I wanted. But from the very first visit they have stood out. The lobby is bright and welcoming. Yummy treat jars! Smart, engaged doctors, nurses and techs. Such sweet staff and the communication is top notch. I feel like they are always there for us. It’s just different!! I’m so glad I found them. And special shout out to Heather for the extra special care during a tough time! You all are the best. Ola thanks you!
Thank you so much for your review, Federico - the whole team really appreciates it!

Disappointing care here - we were quoted incorrectly and paid nearly double what we were told for spaying our kitten. They also gave us inconsistent and contradictory advice on aftercare which was very confusing.

We also requested specific urine testing for our cat and when we followed up on the results they said they forgot to send them to the lab and the sample had expired, suggesting we come in again to re-run the test (highly inconvenient for both us and our cat who is anxious). We have not heard back on rectifying this issue for a few days and therefore I can’t recommend them.

Very friendly staffs and professional nurses and vets. They have quiet room for us to wait, and served the option that we were able to stay with our kitten for her procedure and actually be in the consultation room pre and post surgery. Wonderful and smooth service and experience for us and our kitten!
Excellent friendly, considered and helpful service in a pleasant welcoming environment. The remote 'triage' consultations and advice has been brilliant too. Extremely pleased with this vets.

I have nothing but positive things to say about Hello Vet and the London Fields branch. I used to be with a different vet company who lacked care, empathy, kindness and consideration for both pet and owners. I came across Hello Vets online and to my surprise they had two branches right near me. Not only are they easy to get hold of on WhatsApp where you can message them about literally anything concerning your cat but they are so so kind and helpful. I really cannot express how thankful I am for all the help and support they have given me. I have finally neutered 1/3 of my male cats and he was taken care of by the staff amazingly. I love the feel of the London Fields branch and I am ever so grateful for all the support and advice they have given me from before booking the neutering to during the appointment and even after the surgery. I will be booking my second cat in soon. I love this place and I’m so happy it exists!

Dr Jordan and Dr Kirsty handled my pet with such care, kindness and compassion. They were both incredibly professional and reassuring, and I felt confident that my pet was in the best hands. Thank you so much for looking after them so well. I would definitely recommend them to anyone looking for a caring and trustworthy vet! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Hi Kaci, we're sorry to see this rating. I've had a look through our records and can't find a time you visited us recently, but, I'd really appreciate the chance to understand further. If you're able to, please reach out - I'd genuinely welcome the opportunity to talk this through and put things right if we've fallen short.
Dr Alex
Very nice setup and people but charged £44 for an eye ointment that's designed for humans and is only £5.50 online leaves me with a very sour taste. Added to the £60 consultation already paid.
Really appreciate how thorough and kind everyone is here. My kitten has been so well looked after it’s almost a treat visiting the vet instead of it being something nerve wracking. Thank you!!

I took my dog to Hello Vet today after he broke his claw while playing with a ball in London Fields. I searched for a nearby vet and contacted them straight away. They gave us an appointment within minutes!The staff was amazing, very calm, and supportive. Sass was incredible with Toby . She was so professional, calm,  and since English is not my first language, she was extremely patient and explained everything clearly.Thank you so much to the whole team for your help today!
Thank you for your kind review, Rachael - it really means a lot to the whole team!

If I could give more than 5* I would - everything from start to finish was just exceptional here. The friendliest reception team (incl a dog pick and mix station.) My dog is incredibly anxious and Helen was completely and utterly incredible - putting him completely at ease with a most fantastic array of treats. I’ve never seen my dog’s tail wag in a vet before and now I feel he’ll be pulling me back for a revisit. Thank you so much

Can’t fault any of the treatment we received while our dog was alive and she loved going in to the clinics for treatment and check ups. The transparent pricing was also really good. Being able to contact them via WhatsApp is super convenient and saved us a few trips that wouldn’t have been necessary. You can tell all the staff really do care about every animal in there and I would register further pets with them.

However, I think there is room for improvement with handling an animal passing. The staff were all very lovely and sensitive towards the situation (and I don’t want to seem entitled here) but we didn’t receive any kind of bereavement card/gift. Our insurers, dog food company, joint supplement company, and the crematorium we used all sent us cards and flowers or seeds. We didn’t receive anything from hello vet despite spending thousands of pounds there over the last year so a small card would have been a nice touch. We also only had one animal registered with them but despite her being marked as deceased in their system I haven’t been removed from the email list which has been a bit upsetting to continue to receive emails about how to keep your pet comfortable in the summer, and dental costs… I have since manually unsubscribed myself now.

Big thank you to Dr Emma and Dr Joe for their immaculate greyhound care (along with all other members of the team) the practices are also super clean and don’t feel horrible and clinical like other vets I’ve used in the past. The free treats were very popular with Nanna and unlike our previous vet, Nanna never came back with fleas!

Edit: updated 4 stars to 5. I was contacted by hello vet after they saw my review and profusely apologised for the card situation, the lady I spoke to was actually the person who wrote our card initially but somehow it got lost. To make up for it they sent us another card signed by lots of the staff, a bunch of flowers, and made a donation to the rescue I got Nanna from originally. They really do care so it’s just unfortunate that this mistake happened however they really did their best to rectify it and for that we are very grateful.
